intro.text: The leader of a gang of bandits in the Final Empire.

items.text: When Allrianne Cett rode west alone looking for her father's army, Hobart's gang charged down a hillside to rob and attack her. She Rioted their emotions instead, glad of an easy escort, and convinced Hobart that her father would pay well for her safe return; he suddenly turned courteous.

His gang led Allrianne to the army, since she had been heading the wrong way. She smoothed things over with Cett's guards and had the bandits fed and housed, and told her father that some gold and company would be enough to hire them as mercenaries to guard his supply lines.

appearance.text: Missing most of his teeth and some fingers. He and his men carry weapons, wear ragged, ash-stained clothes and smell strongly.

personality.text: Simple-minded, interested only in money, food and other base desires, which makes him and his gang easy to sway with emotional Allomancy.
